zoe_sales: Quick sync — SprocketBank wants a 2-week POC: support triage + onboarding doc extraction. They asked for acceptance criteria, token estimate, and a baseline prompt set. Can SE/ML draft? cc @alec_se @mira_ml

alec_se: Sure. Two flows: Support messages (~100 tokens) -> intent + single recommended action. Docs (~600 tokens) -> extract fields (name, dob, tax_id, account_id) + 1-line summary. Concurrency target: ~20 rps peak.

mira_ml: Proposed minimal prompt inventory: intent classifier (one-token), action suggester (JSON with action/confidence), extractor (strict JSON schema), summary (1-2 sentences), and a safety redaction step. We'll use small seed sets for evals.

alec_se: Prompt examples (short):
```
System: Return one of {billing, access, onboarding, fraud, other}.
User: "{text}"
Assistant: <intent>
```

mira_ml: Eval plan: 120 messages for intent/action, 120 docs for extraction. Metrics: intent acc >= 0.90, action precision >= 0.85, extraction F1 >= 0.87. Latency target p95 < 400ms on a reserved small instance.

sam_cs: Token burn ask — they want monthly estimate for 800 DAU, avg 2 requests/day (mix).

mira_ml: Rough calc: avg request 450 tokens -> 800*2*450 = 720k tokens/day -> ~21.6M/month. Add 20% overhead -> ~26M tokens/month => ~$520/month at hosted rates. Include Dedicated pricing option.

alec_se: Data handling: they require EU residency and no PII in logs. We'll add a pre-ingest redaction and set no-persist on model cache. Legal needs DPA addendum.

infra-bot: EU cluster available; provisioning in 24-48h after approval.

alec_se: POC timeline (10 business days): day0 kick + samples, days1-3 prompt curation + seed runs, days4-7 integration + load tests, days8-9 acceptance, day10 demo + handoff docs. Deliverables: prompt inventory, eval report, cost estimate, runbook.

zoe_sales: I'll request samples and legal contact. Everyone ack? :thumbsup:

alec_se: ack

mira_ml: ack

sam_cs: ack
